newsitem.title: GERMANY: Aznar meets Kohl in Germany for Europe talks.
newsitem.headline: Aznar meets Kohl in Germany for Europe talks.

text.p: Spanish Prime Minister Jose Maria Aznar met Chancellor Helmut Kohl in Germany on Tuesday for talks focusing on the European Union, a German government spokesman and diplomats said.

Kohl welcomed Aznar as he arrived in Frankfurt airport on Tuesday afternoon. The two leaders then visited the cathedral in the nearby town of Speyer, before travelling on to the southern city of Heidelberg for talks.
"There is no fixed agenda. But the talks are likely to focus on the European Union as well as other themes," a German government spokesman said.
Diplomatic sources said the talks would probably home in on the planned single European currency, which Spain wants to join in the first wave of entrants.

The government spokesman said Kohl had invited Aznar to Speyer, in his home state of Rhineland-Palatinate, and Heidelberg for informal talks which were part of his general efforts to keep up personal contact with all EU leaders.
The leaders of the EU member states meet in December in Dublin to discuss Europe's future and which states are likely to qualify for the single currency due to be launched in 1999.
